a4.kitchen_walls.text: It's so bright! I'll need my sunglasses for tea.

a4.kitchen_floor.text: No more wobbly corner. Hajurama can stop warning everyone.

a4.stove.text: A new stove! My sel roti will be even better now.

a4.cupboard.text: The door didn't fall on me! It works!

a4.spice_shelf.text: Every spice in its own jar. Like your candies, nani!

a4.window.text: You can see the shop sign from up here!

a4.curtain.text: Pretty! Where did you get that cloth?

a4.table.text: Dinner at a real table! No more eating on the stairs.

a4.chair.text: Glue, nails and a little prayer... I mean, patience!

a4.frames.text: There's your mother at your age. Same smile.

a4.arrive.text: Welcome upstairs, nani. Mind the third step, it squeaks.
Hajurama, is that stove... held together with string?

a4.outro.text: Now this is a kitchen worth cooking in!
I'm coming for dinner. Every night.
Didi, the living room still smells like old socks.
Then that's next. Windows open, Bhai!
